map.基于 PDCA 循环的化妆品质量检查-评估-改进机制，输出各阶段成熟度与改进路径: A PDCA-based cosmetic quality check-assess-improve mechanism that outputs the maturity and improvement path of each stage
map.按 PDCA 四阶段（计划-执行-检查-改进）逐项评分，均权得到体系成熟度。C（: Score each of the four PDCA stages (plan, do, check, act) and take the equal-weight average as system maturity. C (check) supplies the data and A (act) forms the closed loop; a weak stage drags the composite score down, which locates the bottleneck.
map.对各阶段能力打分（1-5分），1=未建立，2=初步建立，3=部分实施，4=有效运: Score each stage capability (1-5), where 1 = not established, 2 = initially established, 3 = partially implemented, 4 = running effectively, 5 = continuously optimized
map.PDCA 循环：Plan(计划) → Do(执行) → Check(检查) →: PDCA cycle: Plan → Do → Check → Act
map.成熟度 1-5 分，综合得分反映质量管理闭环水平: Maturity 1-5 points; the composite score reflects how closed-loop the quality management is
map.建议每季度评估一次，持续推动质量改进: Evaluate once a quarter and keep driving quality improvement
map.📚 深度解析：化妆品质量 PDCA 评估: 📚 In-depth analysis: cosmetic quality PDCA assessment
map.质量负责人用 PDCA 循环（计划-执行-检查-改进）评估体系成熟度。: A quality lead uses the PDCA cycle (plan, do, check, act) to assess system maturity.
map.体系审核时对各阶段打分，定位薄弱环。: Score each stage during a system audit to locate weak links.
map.咨询顾问给企业做质量体系诊断并输出改进路径。: Consulting advisors diagnose the quality system and deliver an improvement path.
map.设 P（计划）阶段 70 分、D（执行）80 分、C（检查）65 分、A（改进）: Set P (plan) at 70, D (do) at 80, C (check) at 65 and A (act) at 60 (100 each). The equal-weight composite = (70+80+65+60) ÷ 4 = 68.75 points. Low C and A show that the check-and-improve loop is weak, so data collection and corrective-action tracking come first.
map.PDCA 四个阶段哪个最关键？: Which of the four PDCA stages matters most?
map.A（改进）常被忽视却最关键——没有有效的纠正与预防，问题会反复发生；C（检查）提: A (act) is often overlooked yet most critical — without effective corrective and preventive action problems recur. C (check) supplies the data, and the two together form the closed loop.
map.成熟度分数怎么用？: How are the maturity scores used?
map.用于横向对比各产品线或历年趋势，低于阈值的阶段列入下季度改进计划，而非一次性达标: To compare product lines against each other and to read trends year over year. Stages below the threshold go into next quarter's improvement plan instead of being treated as a one-off pass.
map.基于 PDCA（计划-执行-检查-改进）循环的化妆品质量改进机制评估工具，对四个: A cosmetic quality improvement mechanism assessment tool based on the PDCA (plan, do, check, act) cycle. It scores 16 capability metrics across the four stages and outputs per-stage maturity, weak links and the priority improvement path.
map.薄弱环节自动识别与排序: Automatic identification and ranking of weak links
